# Inquiry Removal

> Inquiry Removal is a nationwide service focused exclusively on hard inquiry removal across Experian, Equifax, and TransUnion credit reports.

## Start Here

- [Homepage](https://www.inquiryremoval.com/): Hard inquiry removal service overview, proof, situations, process, and free review.
- [How It Works](https://www.inquiryremoval.com/how-it-works/): Review, organization, dispute communications, response review, and follow-through.
- [Pricing](https://www.inquiryremoval.com/pricing/): One-time hard inquiry removal packages based on total inquiry count.
- [Eligibility](https://www.inquiryremoval.com/eligibility/): How to determine whether an inquiry deserves removal review.
- [Situations We Handle](https://www.inquiryremoval.com/situations-we-handle/): Route common inquiry problems to the most relevant guide.

- [Duplicate Inquiries](https://www.inquiryremoval.com/duplicate-inquiries/): Distinguish true duplicate reporting from separate lender pulls.
